I know you have the caveat that this has been simplified, but I think its worth pointing out that you should synchronize access to the ‘threads’ ArrayList, since it is being modified by multiple threads.

Which can be as easy as:

public ArrayList threads = ArrayList.Synchronized(new ArrayList);

Josh,
That is a very good point that I left out of my example. I’ll add (for others reading) that if there are other resources being accessed by multiple threads at once, you can wrap that code with:
mutexInstance.WaitOne();
// code
mutexInstance.Release();
